findings: The homepage and default session/circuit pages selected only the next strictly future race, advancing as soon as the current race start passed.
The ingestion target list excluded started races until final results appeared, leaving a gap while classifications were pending.
No Mexico pre-race prediction snapshots exist. The last saved Mexico update before restart was on 29 October.
During recovery Jolpica returned duplicate qualifying position 8; OpenF1 denied unauthenticated access and FastF1 returned no usable timing.
changes: A separate current-race endpoint keeps the most recent unclassified race in focus for up to 24 hours; the next-race endpoint remains strictly future.
Recent unclassified races remain ingestion targets for seven days independently of the archive budget.
Past races can use verified qualifying participants when final race results are absent.
Race views distinguish results pending, completed and upcoming, with an explicit no-recorded-forecast message.
Archive classification validation rejects duplicate positions and preserves verified phases. Empty phase strings remain missing values.
forecast_policy: No post-start forecast generation, backdating or retrospective report-card predictions.

verification.worker: running, partial while free timing sources are unavailable or invalid
